scope: PQ176-PQ180 record-level typed skill-reward parity audit
policy: Canonical forward PQ reward relationships are authoritative. PQ records, crosslink reports, and reverse indexes are reconciliation/consumer layers; do not infer ownership from character presets or non-PQ acquisition.

records.name: Battle of Resolve: VS Goku Black

findings: All 10 documented skill reward endpoints in PQ176-PQ180 are represented in the canonical forward relationship layer and the PQ skill cross-link report.
No additional skill reward was inferred from basic-reward prose, character ownership, or skill acquisition fields.
Force Edge and Burning Blast remain reward relationships even though direct CaC eligibility evidence is a separate field-level question; reward membership does not establish usable_by_cac.
PQ176's canonical record currently has one skill reward; PQ177 has three; PQ178 has one; PQ179 has two; PQ180 has two.
Ultimate Finish/drop conditions remain attached to the PQ record layer and were not converted into unsupported universal probability claims.
